content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: missing** — no insurance clause exists anywhere in the Agreement (the sole hit for "insurance" is in the net-revenue definition at p0012).

- **Direction check:** Commerce One is the vendor to Corio — it places a full-time operations consultant on site (§5.1), provides professional/consulting services (§5.2, §5.6) and operates the MarketSite.net Service. That squarely triggers the rule; a services/hosting vendor with zero coverage is walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new §14.10 Insurance inserted after the Bankruptcy clause — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, statutory workers' comp, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, certificates on request — with the existing entire-agreement clause renumbered to 14.11.
- **Negotiation room:** the comment flags the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) so this need not be a sticking point.
